Job Title: Senior Officer - CAT - SPARC

The Senior Officer - CAT - SPARC will be responsible for driving the operational efficiency of the SPARC (Strategic Performance and Risk Control) team. The Senior Officer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement strategies that enhance productivity and reduce risks. Additionally, the role involves preparing reports and presentations for senior management, providing actionable insights based on data analysis, and supporting the development of risk management frameworks.

- Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. 
- Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and compliance.

- Understanding of statistical analysis software. 
- Experience with project management tools to track progress and manage tasks. 
- Familiarity with CRM systems and databases related to insurance operations. 

This role is ideal for individuals who are detail-oriented, proactive, and possess a strong desire to contribute to the organizational goals of Axis Max Life Insurance.

title: Deputy General Manager - IPQA
description:
Job Description 
 About the Role We are looking for a DGM IPQA to lead end-to-end quality excellence from Line Assembly to PDI , drive a Zero Defects culture , strengthen customer quality, and institutionalize robust CAPA, process audits, and digital quality systems through strong leadership and continuous improvement. 
 This is a strategic quality leadership role requiring strong experience in automotive quality, process audits, CAPA, problem-solving, quality management systems, and shop-floor quality management . 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead Line Assembly to PDI Quality Management by ensuring product quality compliance, monitoring critical quality checkpoints, and preventing defect escapes. Drive Internal CAPA and Problem Solving for in-house defects and audit findings using 7 QC Tools, 8D, Why-Why and Fishbone analysis. Plan and conduct Process Audits across assembly lines and PDI, ensuring compliance with QMS, work instructions and control plans. Drive Zero Defects and Continuous Improvement initiatives through data analysis, audit insights and quality improvement projects. Lead Gemba and Daily Quality Management by conducting shop-floor reviews, engaging cross-functional teams and ensuring timely action-plan closure. Manage Customer Quality by supporting customer quality requirements and coordinating corrective and preventive actions to improve customer satisfaction. Drive Digital Factory and Quality Systems by ensuring effective system usage, accurate and timely data entry, analysis, and data-driven quality decisions. Lead and develop the Quality Team by allocating tasks, providing technical guidance, coaching team members and ensuring accountability for deliverables. Ensure CAPA effectiveness and recurrence prevention by tracking ownership, closure and verification of corrective actions. Drive quality compliance and performance through effective planning, implementation and monitoring of Quality Management Systems. 
 What We Are Looking For 
 15+ years of experience in the Automotive Industry , with strong exposure to Quality Management and plant quality operations. BE Mechanical / DME with experience in planning, implementation and monitoring of Quality Management Systems. Strong knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plan, 7 QC Tools, CAPA and Root Cause Analysis . Experience in Process Audits, Line Assembly to PDI Quality Management, Gemba, Zero Defects and Continuous Improvement . Strong capability in 8D, Why-Why Analysis, Fishbone Analysis and structured problem-solving . Good understanding of ISO 9001:2008 and quality compliance requirements. Strong presentation, communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Good planning and organizational ability , with proficiency in MS Office and PowerPoint. Ability to use Digital Factory / Quality Management Systems, dashboards and quality data for effective decision-making. High level of motivation to learn and implement new technologies and drive continuous improvement. Proficiency in English and Tamil . Willingness to undertake moderate travel as required.

Key Skills: IPQA,Root Cause Analysis,Continuous Improvement,QMS,Gemba,7 Q,PFMEA,Q
